name: joey-agent
description: Find paths and prepare the next action. Check progress and set approved reminders through connected tools. Send after exact approval. Share outcomes and trust statements only with separate consent.

interface.shortDescription: Activate paths to people with Joey.
defaultPrompt: Use $joey to review my paths and prepare the next action for my approval.
Use $joey-activate-path to prepare an introduction request for <target>.
Use $joey-path-follow-up to prepare the next path action and set an approved reminder or progress check.
Use $joey-tracker-sync to check path progress through my connected email and calendar.
Use $joey-attest to record the relationship and trust statements that I choose to share.
Use $joey-trust to show the relationship context and trust support for <person or agent>.
